description_en:
Stops a single scheduled prefetch plan by prefetch plan ID.
Prerequisites: (1) This operation takes effect only when the execution plan is in the running state. Execution plans in the waiting or failed state cannot be stopped. (2) Whether an execution plan can reach the running state depends on whether the associated site has passed the access verification (site Status=active)
description_zh:
根据预热计划ID停止单个定时预热计划。
前置条件：(1) 仅当执行计划状态为 running 时本接口才生效，waiting 或 failed 状态的执行计划无法被停止；(2) 执行计划能否到达 running 状态取决于所属站点是否已完成接入验证（站点 Status=active）
name: StopScheduledPreloadExecution

parameters.help_en: The prefetch plan ID, obtained from the SuccessExecutions[].Id field returned by CreateScheduledPreloadExecutions. Before calling this operation, create a prefetch job by calling CreateScheduledPreloadJob, and then create an execution plan by calling CreateScheduledPreloadExecutions
parameters.help_zh: 预热计划ID，由 CreateScheduledPreloadExecutions 返回的 SuccessExecutions[].Id 字段获取。调用本接口前需先通过 CreateScheduledPreloadJob 创建预热任务，再通过 CreateScheduledPreloadExecutions 创建执行计划
parameters.name: id

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the scheduled prefetch plan, in ISO 8601 format (for example, 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z)
EndTime.description_zh: 定时预热计划结束时间，格式为 ISO 8601（如 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z）

Interval.description_en: The interval between each batch execution of the scheduled prefetch plan, in seconds
Interval.description_zh: 定时预热计划每批执行间隔，单位秒

SliceLen.description_en: The number of URLs prefetched per batch

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the scheduled prefetch plan, in ISO 8601 format (for example, 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z)
StartTime.description_zh: 定时预热计划开始时间，格式为 ISO 8601（如 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z）

Status.description_en:
The status of the scheduled prefetch plan. Valid values:
waiting: Waiting to be executed.
running: Being executed.
finished: Execution completed.
failed: Execution failed.
stopped: Execution paused
Status.description_zh:
定时预热计划的状态，包括如下状态。
waiting：等待被执行。
running：正在执行中。
finished：执行完成。
failed：执行失败。
stopped：暂停执行中
